reviews.x: We have six children eight years old and under. It was driving me bonkers always picking up their toothbrushes off the bathroom floor. These toothbrush covers take care of that problem in a fun, practical way! We’ve had most of ours for almost a year and they are so helpful. The only problem I have with them is that the suction cups were yanked out of two of them by my one year old and after that happened they are not easy to push back in so they easily fell out again and again.  Other than that
I just got my order, but instead of 4 items I just got 3. So I expect to receive the missing one.

These are the cutest toothbrush covers ever!  They do not have a “plastic” smell, nor do they contain an antibacterial chemical.  Two of the package covers had cuts like a razor knife had sliced them, however the animals were not cut.  The covers were made for regular sized toothbrushes.  My granddaughter has a toothbrush that stands on its own.  It is too fat for the cover to completely close around it.  We gave the panda a belt with a ponytail holder and it works fine.
Very cute! My kids loved them. Fit our standard kids toothbrush and our sonicare heads. Did not fit battery operated kids brush. We received a lion, panda, cat, and turtle.

reviews.t: You don't get what is pictured.
reviews.x: Product is fine but it clearly shows a cat as one of the four and we got a panda instead. Five year old granddaughter is not happy and neither is her grandmother. Older granddaughter got what she wanted a dog. I didn't see anywhere that you didn't get what was pictured.

Very disappointed in this product. I had bought a few in the past that were great & was looking to replace. Unfortunately, they no longer make the hole big enough to fit the spin brush heads. Will not order again or recommend.

Our kids loves these, and they work great. Our only caveat is after using them for some time they can develop mold inside and need to be deep cleaned. But they work great, and are good even for young brushers.

reviews.t: Does not hold Electric toothbrush heads
reviews.x: The holes on the bottom are too small to hold an electric toothbrush head. Will use tools to widen the holes to accommodate.
The description and packaging said that there were 4 covers but t only came with three

I had two of these that my oldest children used for the past two years.  They hold up well and stick really well to the mirror.  Add a little water to the suction cup before applying and it's a solid stick.  For my third child, I wanted the same exact brand/model as I was so pleased with the previous ones.  I received a 4 pack of the random assortment from the 6 pictured in the description.  Same great quality!  The only down side is that they are a bit difficult to remove the flaps to clean.  T

These are great toothbrush holders. We received the cat, dog, panda, and turtle. My 6yo son loves the turtle and was really hoping we'd get it. The back of the shell opens which is fun. He has his on the bathroom mirror. It's really easy to put your toothbrush into these and take them out. My 8yo chose the panda and has it next to her brother's. We decided to put the other two into the shower to encourage brushing. Unfortunately, the dog doesn't stick to the shower walls and keeps falling off. T

Great suction. Absolutely adorable. Excellent quality. We’ve had one for 5 years that we finally replaced. We only got a new one cause my little girl wanted a new animal. Otherwise it’s still going strong and looks great. Easy to clean. This set is a great value. We got the puppy, cat, penguin, and turtle. All are so so cute and detailed.

We have limited bathroom counter space so I like these toothbrush holders that stick to the mirror easily.  They are pretty easy to clean but after a long time the plastic hinge will degrade & you will need to replace.  I bought this 4 pack to have replacements handy and received 4 different styles: cat, dog, turtle, and penguin.

I happen to love these toothbrush covers. I ordered these and received a dog, cat, penguin and turtle. They're all adorable. They arrived in perfect condition and extremely fast. I'm very pleased with the purchase. I would recommend them for children and adults. It certainly helps free up sink space!

We took this for our trip on the cruise. With limited counter space, these freed up some space. The suction power is strong. I haven't had to clean it because we used it for one trip. It is more expensive thank the cheaper toothbrush cover. My daughter likes it because it is cute.

I bought these as stocking stuffers for my kids. They work great and are super cute. I wish I could have picked the 4 I wanted because I already owned one and ended up with a duplicate but still worth it! A great way to keep toothbrushes covered and kept in a good spot.

reviews.t: BEST VALUE ANIMAL TOOTH BRUSH COVER
reviews.x: Good Quality sturdy design. I dropped mine and it broke into 3 pcs. I just snap it back like nothing happened. I cannot believe how they have come up with such an amazing product for its price range. Plus its genuinely cute!

Ordered these because they are great to take on vacation.  My only disappointment is the picture shows a dog, but we did not receive a dog.  The other animals are cute, but just disappointed it was not an accurate picture.

I like the suction cups so they can be stuck to our tile wall instead of cluttering up the sink area. I only needed one but they came in a 4 pack so I’ll have back ups. The animals could be a little cuter but it works

I really like these cute toothbrush holders, but I only received 1 of what I thought was going to be 4. Looking at other reviews, this is not a unique problem. I am bummed I paid 15$ for 1 toothbrush holder.
Los diseños son hermosos, los usamos todos en casa; fácil de usar. Se adhieren perfecto; no se dañan optamos por cambiarlos para variar la figura y lo más importante proteje el cepillo de dientes
These are great toothbrush holders. I have never had to re-stick the suction cups. They are for kids but the wife and I think they are a hoot and are functionally perfect so, why not ?
This is a great cover for toothbrushes that are seldom used because the grandkids do not live with us, yet know exactly where there toothbrushes are and they are sanitary.

reviews.t: very cute and helps kids want to brush teeth
reviews.x: loved the suction cups, loved the cuteness. and juat the idea they now want to brush there twth cause they want to tickle the doggies or cats belly makes me super happy
Penguin is hard to open, and hole for toothbrush is for children. Dog is also hard to open but this is all due to design. They stick on the shower wall great

claims.text: Customers frequently describe the covers as cute and adorable, and kids love them.
The suction cups stick well to mirrors, though a few note they don't always stick.
Several reviewers report receiving the wrong number of items or different animals than pictured.
Some customers report the holes are too small to fit electric or spinbrush toothbrush heads.
The covers hold up well over time, though some mention mold or hinge degradation requiring cleaning or replacement.
